text:
Palladium Price in 2001
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2001, the LBMA palladium price fell 58.1% between 2001-01-31 ($1,050) and 2001-12-28 ($440). The highest sampled price was $1,050 in January and the lowest was $320 in October. The mean of these observations was $578. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
